overview: Ordnance Factory Dehu Road (OFDR), Pune, Maharashtra — a key production unit of Munitions India Limited (MIL), Ministry of Defence, Government of India — has issued Full Advertisement No. 1914/96/AOCP(50)/Phase-II/HRM/2026 for engagement of tenure-based contractual personnel.

Offline applications are invited from eligible Ex-Apprentices of AOCP (Attendant Operator Chemical Plant) trade or its feeder trades for the post of Tenure-Based Danger Building Worker (DBW) in Skilled level.
Total Vacancies: 14 Posts. Category Breakdown: SC - 05 Posts, ST - 02 Posts, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) - 03 Posts, EWS - 04 Posts (including 05 horizontal vacancies reserved for Ex-Servicemen).
Not Identified for PwBD: The Danger Building Worker post involves handling explosive ammunition materials and is not identified for PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) candidates.

Pay Structure & Remuneration: Basic Pay of Rs. 19,900/- + Central DA + HRA (if factory quarters are unavailable) + EPF + Bonus + Risk Allowance. Daily remuneration is calculated @ 1/30th of basic pay + DA for an 8-hour shift.
Tenure Period: Engagement is initially for a period of ONE year, extendable up to a maximum period of FOUR years based on factory requirement and individual performance review.

Essential Qualification: Ex-Apprentices of AOCP trade or feeder trades (IMCP, MMCP, LACP, PPO, Fitter General, Machinist, Turner, Sheet Metal Worker, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Boiler Attendant, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Refrigeration & AC Mechanic) from Ordnance Factories OR Government/Private ITIs recognized by NCVT/NCTVT.

Selection Method: Merit list based on 80% weightage for NCTVT (NAC) exam marks + 20% weightage for Trade Test / Practical Test conducted by OFDR Pune, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination.
Application Fee: NIL — Absolutely no application fee for any category.

selectionProcess.description: Offline applications received within 21 days from Employment News publication date are screened for eligibility, trade certificates, age, and valid attachments.

detailsList: Category Breakup: SC - 05, ST - 02, OBC - 03, EWS - 04, Ex-SM - 05 (Horizontal).

Tie Resolution Criteria: In case of equal marks, precedence is given to: (i) Higher marks in NCTVT (NAC) exam -> (ii) Ex-Trade Apprentice of Ordnance Factory Dehu Road, Pune -> (iii) Ex-Trade Apprentice of other Ordnance Factories -> (iv) Older Candidate by Date of Birth.
Not Identified for PwBD: Due to hazardous nature of danger building operations, PwBD candidates are not eligible.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official website of Munitions India Limited at https://munitionsindia.in/career or Department of Defence Production portal at https://ddpdoo.gov.in.
Step 2: Download the official Notification No. 1914/96/AOCP(50)/Phase-II/HRM/2026 and print the prescribed Application Form (Pages 8-11).
Step 3: Fill out the application form completely in BLOCK LETTERS using a blue/black ballpoint pen.

Step 4: Paste a recent passport-size photograph on the application form and firmly paste one extra photo. Enclose two additional self-attested photos with candidate's Name and DOB written on the back side.

Step 5: Enclose self-attested copies of required certificates: (a) Class 10th/SSC Certificate for DOB proof, (b) NCTVT/NCVT NAC Certificate & Marksheet in AOCP or feeder trade, (c) Caste / EWS Certificate in prescribed Central Government format, (d) OBC Creamy Layer Declaration (Appendix-I), (e) Ex-Servicemen Undertaking (Appendix-II) if applicable, (f) Bank account details (cancelled cheque/passbook copy) for SC/ST TA reimbursement.
Step 6: Place the application form and all self-attested enclosures in a envelope.
Step 7: Super-scribe on top of the envelope in bold letters: "APPLICATION FOR 'TENURE BASED DBW (AOCP Trade or Feeder Trade)' PERSONNEL ON CONTRACT BASIS".

Step 8: Send the filled application strictly via Post / Speed Post / Registered Post to: The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Dehu Road, Pune, Maharashtra - 412101 (Tel: 020-27167246 / 020-27167298).
Step 9: Ensure the application reaches OFDR Pune within 21 Days from the date of publication of advertisement in Employment News.

overview: IIFCL Projects Limited (IPL), a prestigious wholly-owned subsidiary of India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL) - a 100% Government of India Enterprise, has officially announced a rolling advertisement for the engagement of Individual Consultants (IC) on a full-time, contractual basis. With a mandate to deliver expert Financial & Infrastructure Advisory services to Central & State Governments, Local Bodies, and Private Developers across India, IPL is building a robust database of highly qualified professionals. This rolling recruitment campaign operates continuously throughout the year, allowing eligible candidates to submit their applications at any time to be considered for active project requirements in multiple sectors, including roads, highways, ports, power, water supply, renewable energy, tourism, and solid waste management.

This recruitment campaign offers a wide array of opportunities, spanning across 65 specialized consultant profiles. These encompass diverse areas such as Project & Contract Management, Procurement, Financial & Costing, IT & MIS, Digital Public Infrastructure, Legal Management, Corporate Communications, Tourism Development, Master Planning, PPP & Investment, and Environmental Affairs. The vacancies are not fixed to a static count, as hiring is on a rolling basis, meaning candidate requirements are fulfilled dynamically as mandates arise. The position grades range from Young Professionals to Senior Consultants (Grades I, II, and III) based on years of post-qualification experience. Selected professionals will be stationed at IPL's Head Office in New Delhi or branch offices and project sites across various States including Amaravati (AP), Chennai, Ahmedabad, the Northeast Region, and other locations on an "Anywhere in India" basis.

The eligibility criteria vary depending on the specific IC Code of interest. Educational requirements range from Graduate degrees in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech), Architecture, Planning, or Law (LLB/LLM) to Postgraduate degrees, MBA/PGDM, CA, CWA, or CFA from recognized premium national or international institutes. Remuneration is highly attractive and structured based on experience: Young Professionals receive a fixed pay of ₹70,000 per month; Grade I Consultants receive between ₹80,000 and ₹1,45,000; Grade II Consultants earn from ₹1,45,000 to ₹2,65,000; and Senior Consultants (Grade III) are eligible for ₹2,65,000 to ₹3,30,000 per month. The upper age limits are 32, 45, 50, and 62 years respectively.

Interested and qualified candidates can apply either by email or physical post. The application window is open for exactly one year from the date of publishing the advertisement, running on a rolling basis. Candidate selection is based entirely on an Interview process (either in Delhi or via online mode), which follows preliminary shortlisting of applicants matching the company's rigorous experience, suitability, and business criteria. There is no application fee for any category, making this a transparent, merit-based entry into one of India's leading government-backed infrastructure advisory firms.

education: General Educational Requirements (Varies by IC Code):
• Engineering Graduates (B.E./B.Tech/B.Arch/B.Plan/M.Tech/M.Plan) in relevant disciplines (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics, IT, Computer Science, etc.).
• Postgraduates/Master's degrees in technology, engineering, finance, economics, business management (MBA/PGDM), planning, or equivalent from premier national/international institutes.
• Law Graduates (LLB or LLM) from recognized premier universities or national law schools.
• Professionally qualified Chartered Accountants (CA), Certified Cost Accountants (CWA), or Certified Financial Analysts (CFA) or Company Secretaries.
• Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management/Environmental Studies/ESG/Sustainability/Urban Design/Tourism from reputed institutes.
Experience Requirements (Grade-wise):
• Young Professional (Grade YP): Minimum 1 year of relevant post-qualification experience.
• Consultant Grade I (Grade I): Minimum 3 to 8 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
• Consultant Grade II (Grade II): Minimum 8 to 15 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
• Senior Consultant Grade III (Grade III): Minimum 15 years or more of relevant post-qualification experience.
General Conditions:
• All educational qualifications must be obtained from recognized universities, institutes, or boards approved by UGC, AICTE, or AIU (Government of India).
• Candidates with qualification acquired from a foreign (international) Institute/University must produce an equivalency certificate issued by the Competent Authority.

salary.initialPay:
The monthly remuneration ranges are structured according to the Grade Codes:

• Young Professional (YP): Fixed at ₹70,000 per month (Requires 1 year experience)
• Consultant (Grade I): ₹80,000 to ₹1,45,000 per month (Requires 3 - 8 years experience)
• Consultant (Grade II): ₹1,45,000 to ₹2,65,000 per month (Requires 8 - 15 years experience)
• Senior Consultant (Grade III): ₹2,65,000 to ₹3,30,000 per month (Requires 15+ years experience)

Note: The final remuneration for selected candidates shall be decided based on their expectations, experience, and expertise, and the decision of IPL shall be final. In addition, TA/DA and Hotel Accommodation will be paid/reimbursed as per Company policy for official tours.

selectionProcess.description: Candidates must submit their application form (editable MS Word and PDF) with required documents via email or physical post. Separate applications must be submitted for each IC Code and Grade Code.
Applications are screened and candidates shortlisted based on qualifications, experience, suitability, city preference, and business requirements of IPL verticals.
Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Interviews may be conducted in Delhi or via online mode at the sole discretion of the Company. No travel reimbursement is paid.
Initial contract is for 2 years. Continuation beyond the first and subsequent years is strictly contingent on satisfactory performance reviews based on KPIs.

examPattern.negativeMarking: No written exam is conducted. Recruitment is purely based on shortlisting followed by Personal Interview.

topics: Core Technical Knowledge: Domain expertise matching the specific IC Code and Specialisation (e.g. Roads, Ports, Energy, PPP Structuring, Finance, Legal, IT & MIS).
Infrastructure Advisory: Formulation of DPRs, TEFRs, bid process management, and understanding of public procurement systems (such as GeM or CPP portals).

Candidates must explicitly state the correct "IC Code" and "Grade Code" against which they are applying in their application.
An applicant has to apply separately for each IC Code and Grade Code. Multiple profiles combined in a single application are not allowed.
Mere satisfaction of eligibility norms does not entitle an applicant to be called for Interview.
An applicant applying for a higher grade shall not make him/her automatically eligible for a grade lower to the one applied for.

Canvassing in any form of any kind will lead to automatic disqualification of the candidate.

faqs.question: What is the full form of IPL, and who is its parent organization?
faqs.answer: IPL stands for IIFCL Projects Limited, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL), a 100% Government of India Enterprise.

faqs.question: What is the main objective of IIFCL Projects Limited (IPL)?
faqs.answer: The main objective of IPL is to provide Financial & Infrastructure Advisory services to various Central & State Governments, their affiliates, Local Bodies, and Private Developers, along with Capacity Building and Policy Advocacy services.

faqs.question: What is the nature of the engagement for the Individual Consultants (IC) positions?
faqs.answer: The engagement of Individual Consultants is on a full-time, contractual basis. Selected candidates are not allowed to take up any other appointment, engagement, or assignment during their contract period.

faqs.question: Where will the selected Individual Consultants be stationed?
faqs.answer: Selected consultants are expected to be stationed at IPL's Head Office in Delhi, and/or any of its branch offices, and/or across various States wherein IPL is currently working or intends to work under mandate.

faqs.question: What does rolling recruitment mean for this IPL notification?
faqs.answer: It means that applications are accepted and evaluated throughout the year on an as-and-when needed basis. IPL maintains an active database of applications, and candidates are selected from this pool whenever vacancies arise in specific areas of work.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the rolling applications window?
faqs.answer: The applications window is open for exactly one year from the date of publishing the advertisement.

faqs.question: What are the four grades of Individual Consultants, and what is their required experience?
faqs.answer: The grades are: (1) Young Professional with 1 year experience; (2) Consultant Grade I with 3 - 8 years experience; (3) Consultant Grade II with 8 - 15 years experience; and (4) Senior Consultant with 15 years or more experience.

faqs.question: What is the monthly remuneration for a Young Professional?
faqs.answer: A Young Professional is paid a fixed monthly consolidated remuneration of ₹70,000.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary range for a Consultant Grade I?
faqs.answer: The monthly remuneration range for Consultant Grade I is ₹80,000 to ₹1,45,000.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary range for a Consultant Grade II?
faqs.answer: The monthly remuneration range for Consultant Grade II is ₹1,45,000 to ₹2,65,000.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary range for a Senior Consultant (Grade III)?
faqs.answer: The monthly remuneration range for Senior Consultant (Grade III) is ₹2,65,000 to ₹3,30,000.

faqs.question: How is the final remuneration decided for selected candidates?
faqs.answer: The final remuneration within the corresponding grade band is decided based on the candidate's expectations, experience, and expertise. The decision of IPL is final and binding.

faqs.question: Is TA/DA provided for official tours during the engagement?
faqs.answer: Yes. Consultants are allowed to undertake official tours as required by their duties, and TA/DA and Hotel Accommodation are paid or reimbursed as per the company's policy.

faqs.question: What are the upper age limits for different grades of consultants?
faqs.answer: The upper age limits are: 32 years for Young Professional, 45 years for Consultant Grade I, 50 years for Consultant Grade II, and 62 years for Senior Consultant.

faqs.question: What are the essential academic qualifications required to apply?
faqs.answer: Qualifications depend on the specific IC Code but generally include regular Graduation/Post Graduation in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech/B.Arch/B.Plan/M.Tech/M.Plan), Master's/Postgraduate degrees, MBA, CA, CWA, CFA, LLB, or LLM from recognized premier institutes.

faqs.question: Are candidates with degrees from foreign universities eligible?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided they can produce an equivalency certificate issued by a Competent Authority certifying that their foreign qualification is treated at par with qualifications offered by Indian Institutes/Universities.

faqs.question: What is the selection procedure for these consultant posts?
faqs.answer: The selection is done through a Personal Interview after preliminary screening and shortlisting of applications based on qualifications, experience, suitability, city preference, and business requirements.

faqs.question: Where will the Personal Interviews be conducted, and is travel allowance provided?
faqs.answer: Shortlisted applicants will attend the interview in Delhi or online. No travel expense reimbursement (TA/DA) is paid for appearing in the interview.

faqs.question: What is the initial period of engagement for these contractual positions?
faqs.answer: Individual Consultants are engaged for an initial fixed period of two years.

faqs.question: Can the period of contract be extended, and what is the maximum limit?
faqs.answer: Yes, the contract can be extended by one year at a time up to a maximum tenure of 5 years (i.e. 2+1+1+1 years), contingent on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on KPIs.

faqs.question: How can candidates apply for this recruitment, and are there different email addresses?
faqs.answer: Candidates must apply by email or post. There are separate email addresses: recruitment1@iifclprojects.com for IC Codes 01 to 10; recruitment2@iifclprojects.com for IC Codes 13 to 46; and recruitment3@iifclprojects.com for IC Codes 11, 12, and 47 to 65.

faqs.question: What documents must be submitted along with the application?
faqs.answer: Submission requires: the filled application form in MS Word (Editable) and PDF formats (signed on each page), a signed Advertisement Notice, copies of educational certificates/marksheets, experience certificates, latest salary slips, and an equivalency certificate if applicable.

faqs.question: What is the subject line format required for sending the application by email?
faqs.answer: The Subject Line format must be: "Application_ IC CODE_ [Insert IC Code] _ [Name of Applicant]" (e.g. Application_ IC CODE_ 01 _ Rahul Sharma).

faqs.question: What is the physical postal address to submit applications?
faqs.answer: AGM- HR, IIFCL Projects Limited (IPL), 3rd Floor, Tower - E, World Trade Centre (WTC), Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi - 110029.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply for more than one Individual Consultant post?
faqs.answer: Yes, but the applicant must apply separately for each IC Code and Grade Code.

faqs.question: What happens if a candidate provides incorrect or falsified documents?
faqs.answer: Their candidature will stand cancelled immediately at any stage of selection, and if detected after appointment, their services are liable to be terminated without any compensation.

faqs.question: What is the official advertisement number for Cochin Shipyard PMIS Internship 2026?
faqs.answer: The official notification advertisement number is CSL/P&A/HRM/HRM GENERAL/PM_INTERNSHIP_SCHEME/2024/45 dated 26 August 2026.

faqs.question: How many total internship seats are available in Cochin Shipyard under PMIS 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 227 internship seats are available: ITI Trades (92 seats), SSLC (80 seats), HSE/ITI (27 seats), Diploma (16 seats), General Graduation (11 seats), and Post Graduation (1 seat).

faqs.question: What is the duration of the internship training in CSL?
faqs.answer: The internship training is for a fixed period of Nine (9) months under the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS).

faqs.question: What is the monthly stipend offered to CSL PMIS interns?
faqs.answer: Interns in SSLC, ITI, and HSE disciplines receive Rs. 11,000/- per month, while Diploma, Graduate, and PG interns receive Rs. 13,000/- per month, inclusive of Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) by the Government of India.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for Cochin Shipyard PMIS Internship 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 25 years of age to apply under the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faqs.answer: There is NO application fee (NIL). Applying through the PMIS portal is completely free for all candidates.

faqs.question: How will candidates be selected for the CSL PMIS internship?
faqs.answer: Selection is strictly based on the percentage of marks obtained in the prescribed qualification. In case of a tie in marks, relative merit is decided based on seniority in age, followed by certificate verification and medical fitness.

faqs.question: Who is NOT eligible (Ineligibility Criteria) to apply for PMIS at CSL?
faqs.answer: Graduates from IITs/IIMs/NLUs/IISER/IIITs/IISc; holders of CA/CMA/CS/MBBS/BDS/MD/MS/MBA/MPhil/PhD; candidates who have already completed NATS/NAPS apprenticeship; candidates currently in govt training; candidates whose family annual income exceeds Rs. 12 Lakhs; or candidates whose family member is a permanent/regular govt employee are NOT eligible.

faqs.question: Can B.Tech / Engineering Degree holders apply for the Graduate Clerical intern posts?
faqs.answer: No, the Graduate Clerical intern seats are open for non-B.Tech and non-performing arts graduates (e.g. BA, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, BCA).

faqs.question: Are candidates with ITI NTC certificates eligible for ITI trades?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates who have passed 10th standard and possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the relevant ITI trade (Fitter, Electrician, Welder, Machinist, Draughtsman, Diesel Mech, etc.) are eligible.

faqs.question: Does completion of this internship guarantee employment in Cochin Shipyard?
faqs.answer: No, upon completion of the 9-month internship training, CSL has no obligation to offer regular employment, nor can interns claim any right for appointment on the grounds of internship completion.

faqs.question: Is boarding or lodging provided by Cochin Shipyard during the internship?
faqs.answer: No, boarding and lodging are not provided by CSL during the internship period. Interns must make their own living arrangements in Kochi.

faqs.question: Where and how do I submit the online application for CSL PMIS Internship?
faqs.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official Prime Minister Internship Scheme Portal at https://pminternship.mca.gov.in/login/ and select Cochin Shipyard Limited opportunities.

faqs.question: Will offer letters be sent by post?
faqs.answer: No, offers of internship training will NOT be sent by post. Shortlisted candidates will receive notifications and offer letters directly through the PMIS portal.

faqs.question: What is the official contact email for queries related to CSL Apprenticeship / PMIS?
faqs.answer: For queries regarding CSL internship, candidates can email apprenticeship@cochinshipyard.in. For technical issues with the PMIS portal, use the Support section on pminternship.mca.gov.in.

overview: The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has officially published mega Advertisement Notification No. 09 of 2026 dated 01 September 2026 for the direct recruitment of 2,863 Class-IV (Multi-Tasking Staff - MTS) and Sanitation Worker vacancies in various Government Departments across UT, Divisional, and District Cadres.

The recruitment covers 105 UT Cadre posts, 1,093 Divisional Cadre Jammu posts, 897 Divisional Cadre Kashmir posts, and 768 District Cadre posts spread across all 20 districts of Jammu & Kashmir in major departments including Public Works (R&B), Animal/Sheep Husbandry, Floriculture, Higher Education, Estates, Culture, and Agriculture Production.

Under S.O. 184 of 2020 and SRO 99 of 2008, the educational qualification for Class-IV (MTS) is strictly Minimum Matric (10th) and Maximum 10+2, while for Sanitation Worker it is Minimum 8th Pass and Maximum 10+2. Candidates with higher qualifications beyond 10+2 are not eligible. Selected personnel will be placed in Pay Level SL-1 (Rs. 14,800 - 47,100/-). The online application window is open from 05 October 2026 to 03 November 2026 on www.jkssb.nic.in.

faqs.question: What are the application start and closing dates for JKSSB Class IV Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Online applications commence on 05 October 2026 and close on 03 November 2026 on the official portal www.jkssb.nic.in.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for Class-IV (MTS)?
faqs.answer: As per S.O. 184 of 2020, the Minimum qualification is Matric (10th Pass) and Maximum qualification is 10+2. Candidates with higher qualifications than 10+2 are strictly ineligible.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification for Sanitation Worker posts?
faqs.answer: As per S.O. 132 of 2022, the Minimum qualification is 8th Pass and Maximum qualification is 10+2.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for JKSSB Class IV recruitment?
faqs.answer: As on 01 January 2026, the upper age limit is 40 years for Open Merit (OM), 43 years for SC/ST/RBA/ALC-IB/OBC/EWS, 42 years for PwBD, up to 48 years for Ex-Servicemen, and casual workers get 5 years relaxation.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for JKSSB Advertisement 09 of 2026?

faqs.question: How is the 100-marks selection score calculated?
faqs.answer: For UT Cadre: Written Test (85) + Socio-Economic criteria (15). For Divisional Cadre: Written Test (80) + Home Division (5) + Socio-Economic (15). For District Cadre: Written Test (75) + Home District (10) + Socio-Economic (15).

faqs.question: What socio-economic weightage criteria are included under S.O. 184?
faqs.answer: 5 marks for no family member in government service (certified by SDM/ADC), 5 marks for widows/divorced women/orphan girls (certified by Tehsildar), and 5 marks for casual workers engaged for 5 years or more.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for JKSSB Class-IV (MTS) posts?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates will receive Pay Level SL-1 with a pay scale of Rs. 14,800 - 47,100/- plus applicable DA, HRA, and medical allowances.

faqs.question: Is negative marking applicable in the written examination?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is negative marking of 0.25 (one-fourth) marks for each wrong answer in the objective-type examination.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply for multiple cadre items?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for multiple cadre items based on eligibility and preference, but only one application per item number is permitted.

overview: Central University of Punjab (CUPB), Bathinda (a premier Central University established by an Act of Parliament) has officially issued employment notification Advt. No. CUPB/26-27/012 (dated 02 September 2026) for filling 15 Teaching and Non-Teaching positions purely on temporary and contractual basis. The positions include 1 Contractual Faculty (Self-Finance) in B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering, 8 Part-Time Faculty positions on lecture basis across Music, Law, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, and Economics for ITEP B.Sc.-B.Ed. / B.A.-B.Ed., and 6 Contractual Non-Teaching positions (Senior Analyst, Laboratory Assistant, and Laboratory Attendant).

Selected candidates for teaching posts will receive attractive consolidated emoluments up to Rs. 64,000/- per month (or Rs. 1,000/- per lecture up to Rs. 50,000/- per month for part-time faculty). Non-teaching personnel will receive fixed monthly emoluments of Rs. 65,000/- (Senior Analyst), Rs. 40,800/- (Laboratory Assistant), and Rs. 28,800/- (Laboratory Attendant). Candidates must possess requisite Master's/Ph.D./NET or B.Tech/Diploma/Degree/10+2 Science qualifications with relevant laboratory or teaching experience.

Candidates must register online on the respective Samarth portals (https://cuprec.samarth.edu.in for Faculty and https://cupnt.samarth.edu.in for Non-Teaching) before the deadline mentioned for each post (09 to 15 September 2026, 10:00 AM). Applicants must attend the Walk-in Interview at the Main Campus, VPO Ghudda, Bathinda with printed online application forms, original documents, experience certificates, and a 10-minute presentation (for faculty positions).

faqs.question: How many total vacancies are announced under CUPB Advt. CUPB/26-27/012?
faqs.answer: A total of 15 vacancies are announced: 1 Contractual Faculty (CSE), 8 Part-Time Faculty on lecture basis, 1 Senior Analyst, 3 Laboratory Assistants, and 2 Laboratory Attendants.

faqs.question: What is the mode of recruitment for CUPB Advt 26-27/012?
faqs.answer: Selection is through Walk-in Interview at the Main Campus, Ghudda, Bathinda, preceded by mandatory online application registration on the CUPB Samarth portal.

faqs.question: What are the interview dates for CUPB Faculty and Non-Teaching posts?
faqs.answer: Interviews will be held from 09 September 2026 to 15 September 2026 depending on the post (09 & 10 Sept for Part-Time Faculty, 11 Sept for Contractual Faculty & Senior Analyst, 14 Sept for Biotech/Comm. Medicine Lab staff, and 15 Sept for CSE Lab staff).

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary / honorarium offered by CUPB?
faqs.answer: Senior Analyst: Rs. 65,000/-, Contractual Faculty (CSE): Rs. 64,000/-, Lab Assistant: Rs. 40,800/-, Lab Attendant: Rs. 28,800/-, and Part-Time Faculty: Rs. 1,000/- per lecture up to Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for CUPB Walk-in recruitment?
faqs.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for General, OBC, and EWS candidates. SC, ST, PwD, and Women candidates are completely exempted from payment of fees.

faqs.question: Where will the walk-in interviews be conducted?
faqs.answer: Interviews will take place at the Central University of Punjab, Badal-Bathinda Road, V.P.O. Ghudda, District Bathinda - 151401 (Punjab). Reporting time is 09:00 AM on the respective interview date.

faqs.question: Is online registration required before attending the interview?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates must register online and submit the application on https://cuprec.samarth.edu.in (for Faculty) or https://cupnt.samarth.edu.in (for Non-Teaching) before 10:00 AM on the day of the interview.

faqs.question: What qualification is needed for Senior Analyst at CUPB?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess a UG or PG degree in Science or Engineering with minimum 55% marks along with 4 to 5 years research experience in Food/Water testing (preferably NABL lab). ISO/IEC 17025 training is desirable.

faqs.question: What qualification is required for Laboratory Assistant?
faqs.answer: Bachelor's degree in relevant discipline (Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, etc.) with at least 2 years experience handling sophisticated laboratory instruments.

faqs.question: What qualification is required for Laboratory Attendant?
faqs.answer: 10+2 with Science stream OR 10th pass with Science subject and 2 years laboratory experience in a recognized institution or university.

faqs.question: Do faculty candidates need to give a presentation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Faculty applicants must deliver a 10-minute PowerPoint presentation in English or Hindi on their selected domain knowledge and intended contributions to the university.

faqs.question: What is the crucial date for checking age and eligibility?
faqs.answer: The upper age limit, qualifications, and experience are counted strictly as on the exact date of Interview for each respective post.

faqs.question: What is the validity requirement for OBC and EWS certificates?
faqs.answer: OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and EWS certificates must be issued on or after 01 April 2026 in the format prescribed by the Government of India.

faqs.question: Can a candidate apply for more than one post?
faqs.answer: Yes, but separate online applications along with separate application fees must be submitted for each post applied for.

faqs.question: Will call letters be sent by post for the interview?
faqs.answer: No separate call letters will be issued. Eligible registered candidates must directly report to the campus at 09:00 AM on the scheduled interview date.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced for National Test House Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 36 vacancies have been officially announced for Young Professionals under National Test House Recruitment 2026.

faqs.question: What is the official Advertisement Number for this National Test House recruitment drive?
faqs.answer: The official advertisement number for this recruitment notification is NATIONAL-TEST-/2026.

faqs.question: What educational qualification is required to apply for Young Professionals in National Test House?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess Graduates/Post graduates. Please refer to the official notification PDF for complete discipline-specific details.

faqs.question: What is the prescribed age limit for National Test House Young Professionals posts?
faqs.answer: The prescribed age limit is As per government recruitment norms (+ standard relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD categories). Standard age relaxations apply for SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen as per government norms.

faqs.question: What is the monthly salary or pay scale offered for Young Professionals in National Test House?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 70,000/-, Rs. 40,000/-, along with admissible allowances as per official organizational policy.

faqs.question: What is the mode of application for National Test House Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The application mode is Apply Offline. Candidates should follow the official submission guidelines carefully.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply or interview date for National Test House Young Professionals?
faqs.answer: The last date for application submission or scheduled event date is 15 days from the date of publication (26 September 2026).

faqs.question: What is the selection process for National Test House Young Professionals recruitment?
faqs.answer: The selection process involves initial scrutiny of qualifications, shortlisting, personal interview / skill assessment / written test, and document verification.

faqs.question: Where will the selected candidates be posted for this National Test House vacancy?
faqs.answer: The selected candidates will be posted in India or designated project sites/campuses under National Test House.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee for National Test House Young Professionals Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Application fee details are specified in the official notification. Reserved categories and female applicants are generally exempt or entitled to concessions.

faqs.question: Are candidates in their final year/semester eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess the requisite degree and final mark sheet on or before the crucial closing date specified in the notification.

faqs.question: Is age relaxation applicable for reserved category applicants?
faqs.answer: Yes, standard age relaxations (5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, and 10+ years for PwBD) are applicable as per Central/State Government rules.

faqs.question: What documents are required during interview and verification?
faqs.answer: Candidates must carry 10th certificate for DOB proof, degree certificates, all semester mark sheets, caste certificate, experience certificates, photo ID proof, and self-attested photocopies.

faqs.question: Can candidates currently employed in Government/PSU apply?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates working in Central/State Government or PSUs can apply provided they produce a 'No Objection Certificate' (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview.

faqs.question: How can I download the official notification PDF for National Test House Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded directly from the official link: https://www.nth.gov.in.

faqs.question: Is this a permanent post or contractual engagement in National Test House?
faqs.answer: Please refer to the official advertisement (NATIONAL-TEST-/2026) for the precise tenure and engagement terms (regular/contractual/project-basis) for Young Professionals.

faqs.question: Where can I check updates regarding admit cards, interview schedules, or results for National Test House?
faqs.answer: All official updates, interview lists, and result notices will be published directly on the official National Test House recruitment portal: https://www.nth.gov.in.

faqs.question: Can candidates from all states and UTs in India apply for National Test House vacancies?
faqs.answer: Yes, Indian citizens fulfilling the required educational qualification, age limit, and language proficiency criteria are eligible to apply.

faqs.question: What should I do if there is a discrepancy in my online application details?
faqs.answer: Candidates must verify all details before final submission. In case of corrections, check the official National Test House portal during the edit window if provided.

faqs.question: Who can be contacted for technical assistance regarding National Test House recruitment application?
faqs.answer: Candidates may contact the official helpdesk or email address provided on the National Test House official website.

overview: Jharkhand Griha Raksha Vahini (JGRV), District Commandant Office, Deoghar, has officially released employment advertisement notification No. 01/2026 inviting online applications for 772 vacancies for the enrollment of Home Guards (Grih Rakshak - ग्रामीण एवं शहरी गृह रक्षक) across Deoghar district. This recruitment drive offers 635 vacancies for Rural Home Guards across 10 blocks and 137 vacancies for Urban Home Guards across Deoghar and Madhupur municipal areas.

The 772 vacancies are strictly partitioned: 50% of all posts (386 vacancies) are reserved for female candidates (with a 5% horizontal sub-quota for divorced, deserted, and widowed women). For Urban Home Guards, 50% of vacancies are earmarked for technically skilled personnel (doctors, engineers, nurses, drivers, computer operators, electricians, plumbers, etc.) and 50% for non-technical candidates. Educational requirements are 7th class pass for Rural Home Guards and 10th (Matriculation) pass for Urban Home Guards, with age between 19 and 40 years as on 01 January 2026.

Eligible candidates who are permanent residents of the respective blocks (for Rural) or urban areas (for Urban) in Deoghar district must apply online through the official Jharkhand recruitment portal at https://recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in between 11 October 2026 and 26 October 2026 (up to 5:00 PM). The application fee is ₹100 payable online. The selection comprises a multi-tier physical screening test (PET - 1-mile run, high jump, long jump, shot put), followed by a qualifying Hindi writing ability test (100 marks) and technical assessment (for technical candidates).

overview: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC), Vijayawada has released Brief Notification No. 07/2026 (dated 15 September 2026) for direct recruitment to 163 prestigious Group-I Services vacancies in the Government of Andhra Pradesh.

The 163 provisional vacancies span 13 executive cadres including Deputy Collector in A.P. Civil Service (11), Assistant Commissioner of State Tax (14), Deputy Superintendent of Police - Civil (36), DSP Communications (03), District Educational Officer (14), Divisional Development Officer in Panchayat Raj (35), Deputy Registrar of Cooperative Societies (15), Assistant Audit Officer (14), Municipal Commissioner Grade-II (12), and Regional Transport Officer (03).

Pay scales range from ₹54,060–₹1,40,540 up to ₹65,360–₹1,54,980 per month. The educational qualification is a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised university (B.E./B.Tech in ECE/Telecommunication for DSP Communications).

Online applications will be open on the official website (psc.ap.gov.in) from 06 October 2026 to 27 October 2026 (up to 11:59 PM). The selection process comprises an offline OMR-based Screening Test (240 marks), a descriptive Mains Written Examination (750 marks across 5 papers plus qualifying Telugu and English), and an Interview (75 marks) for a total evaluation of 825 marks.
